ring.title: 👁️ **ZERO ARTIFACT TRACKING**
ring.description: 🔍 An anomalous object alters the network. Point to other avatars to help the algorithm debug the threat.
ring.investigation_instructions:
• Initiate **Artifact: Accuse** from the console below
• Write the mention (@) or ID of the suspected avatar
• My algorithm will process a direct interrogation
• The analysis will be made public to transparent the code
ring.investigation_warning:
⚠️ **PHYSICAL RESTRICTIONS:**
• An avatar cannot self-denounce
• Artificial entities (bots) cannot carry the artifact
• The sweep must be initialized by an Archon
ring.inactive_instructions:
To restore tracking:
• An Archon must access the **Admin Artifact** terminal
• Execute **Tracking: Started**
• Calibrate the sweep temporal cycle

Once done, you may point to suspicious carbon signatures.
